result.summary: The image shows a dark-themed user interface for an AI coding assistant application named TRAE ('Build With TRAE'). The left side contains a navigation sidebar with options like 'New task', 'Marketplace', 'Automation', 'My Artifacts', and project lists. The entire right region is a wide canvas featuring a central heading 'Build With TRAE', a prompt input box with settings, model selection ('deepseek-v4.1-flash'), and suggestion chips. At the top-right of this main canvas area sits an 'IDE ↗' button next to a panel toggle icon.
